verification.qualification: Ordinary and Pact Magic slot counters, explicit short/long rests with preview and confirmation, manually entered Hit Die healing, full long-rest Hit Dice recovery and temporary HP expiry. Resource recharge uses an explicit reviewed policy rather than parsing descriptions. Optional choice-based recovery, states/exhaustion, time eligibility and special untracked abilities remain table decisions. Existing version-1 session records remain valid without adding fields on read; older HP-only clients preserve newer slot/Hit Dice/rest fields. Astuce mystique correctly counts one ritual use rather than the number of slots recoverable by that ritual. No catalogue revision or existing-character migration.
